verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a built-in agent platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows only agent creation and management, MCP tool attachment, and a per-command approval gate in `local-ai chat`. Nothing covers version history, diff/review of agent or automation definitions, or rollback. The approval gate and chat-message editing govern individual runtime actions, not versioned automations.
